knowledge:
- key_parameters: uniq=Determines the maximal allowed number of stacked reads per genomic position using a Poisson distribution p-value threshold (0 to keep all, 1 to keep one representative) ;; extend=Length in nucleotides to extend reads in the strand direction (must be 0 if shift is non-zero) ;; shift=Number of nucleotides to shift reads instead of extending them (must be 0 if extend is non-zero) ;; window_size=Size of adjacent genomic windows for coverage calculation ;; chr.select=Vector of chromosomes to restrict the analysis to ;; diff.method=Method for differential coverage calculation ("edgeR" or "ttest") ;; MeDIP=Logical determining whether CpG density-dependent relative methylation scores (rms) are calculated ;; CNV=Logical to enable or disable copy number variation testing using Input samples ;; diffnorm=Normalization method for library sizes or enrichment efficiencies ("tmm", "quantile", "rpkm", "rms", or "none")
- alternatives: Standard peak callers can be used for sample-wise local enrichment identification, but they typically do not correct for CpG density bias. edgeR is preferred for differential coverage when replicates are limited, whereas ttest requires at least 3 replicates per group.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing DNA enrichment sequencing data (e.g., MeDIP-seq, ChIP-seq, MBD-seq) to find genomic regions with significant differential coverage (differential methylation) between two experimental conditions, or to perform quality control on enrichment libraries.
- pitfalls: Ensure that the reference genome version used for mapping matches the BSgenome package version exactly. One of the parameters 'extend' or 'shift' must be set to 0. Merged windows from MEDIPS.mergeFrames contain only genomic coordinates and do not retain summarized coverage or count values. Quantile normalization (diffnorm="quantile") normalizes count data but does not adjust the returned rpkm or rms values. Merged sets created via MEDIPS.mergeSets lose their file associations and cannot be used directly with MEDIPS.addCNV.

workflows.name: differential_coverage_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify genomic regions with significant differential coverage (differential methylation) between two conditions using replicates and input controls.
input: bam.file.hESCs.Rep1.MeDIP (BAM file of IP sample replicate 1)
bam.file.hESCs.Rep2.MeDIP (BAM file of IP sample replicate 2)
bam.file.hESCs.Input (BAM file of Input control for condition 1)
bam.file.DE.Input (BAM file of Input control for condition 2)
workflows.stages: 1. Create MEDIPS sets for IP and Input samples using MEDIPS.createSet ;; 2. Generate a coupling vector for CpG density normalization using MEDIPS.couplingVector ;; 3. Calculate genome-wide coverage, methylation profiles, and differential coverage using MEDIPS.meth ;; 4. Select significant windows using MEDIPS.selectSig ;; 5. Filter and merge adjacent significant windows into regions of interest using MEDIPS.mergeFrames ;; 6. Extract and summarize data at regions of interest using MEDIPS.selectROIs
workflows.code:
hESCs_MeDIP = MEDIPS.createSet(file=bam.file.hESCs.Rep1.MeDIP, BSgenome=BSgenome, extend=extend, shift=shift, uniq=uniq, window_size=ws, chr.select=chr.select)
hESCs_MeDIP = c(hESCs_MeDIP, MEDIPS.createSet(file=bam.file.hESCs.Rep2.MeDIP, BSgenome=BSgenome, extend=extend, shift=shift, uniq=uniq, window_size=ws, chr.select=chr.select))
hESCs_Input = MEDIPS.createSet(file=bam.file.hESCs.Input, BSgenome=BSgenome, extend=extend, shift=shift, uniq=uniq, window_size=ws, chr.select=chr.select)
DE_Input = MEDIPS.createSet(file=bam.file.DE.Input, BSgenome=BSgenome, extend=extend, shift=shift, uniq=uniq, window_size=ws, chr.select=chr.select)
CS = MEDIPS.couplingVector(pattern="CG", refObj=hESCs_MeDIP[[1]])
mr.edgeR = MEDIPS.meth(MSet1=DE_MeDIP, MSet2=hESCs_MeDIP, CSet=CS, ISet1=DE_Input, ISet2=hESCs_Input, p.adj="bonferroni", diff.method="edgeR", MeDIP=T, CNV=F, minRowSum=10)
mr.edgeR.s = MEDIPS.selectSig(results=mr.edgeR, p.value=0.1, adj=T, ratio=NULL, bg.counts=NULL, CNV=F)
mr.edgeR.s.gain = mr.edgeR.s[which(mr.edgeR.s[,grep("logFC", colnames(mr.edgeR.s))]>0),]
mr.edgeR.s.gain.m = MEDIPS.mergeFrames(frames=mr.edgeR.s.gain, distance=1)
columns=names(mr.edgeR)[grep("counts",names(mr.edgeR))]
rois=MEDIPS.selectROIs(results=mr.edgeR, rois=mr.edgeR.s.gain.m, columns=columns, summarize=NULL)
rois.s=MEDIPS.selectROIs(results=mr.edgeR, rois=mr.edgeR.s.gain.m, columns=columns, summarize="avg")

workflows.name: enrichment_quality_control
workflows.intent: Perform quality control analyses on enrichment sequencing libraries, including saturation, sample correlation, sequence pattern coverage, and CpG enrichment.
workflows.stages: 1. Estimate library saturation and reproducibility using MEDIPS.saturation and plot with MEDIPS.plotSaturation ;; 2. Calculate pairwise correlation between multiple samples using MEDIPS.correlation ;; 3. Analyze sequence pattern coverage (e.g., CpG coverage depth) using MEDIPS.seqCoverage and plot with MEDIPS.plotSeqCoverage ;; 4. Calculate CpG enrichment scores relative to the reference genome using MEDIPS.CpGenrich
workflows.code:
sr=MEDIPS.saturation(file=bam.file.hESCs.Rep1.MeDIP, BSgenome=BSgenome, uniq=uniq, extend=extend, shift=shift, window_size=ws, chr.select=chr.select, nit=10, nrit=1, empty_bins=TRUE, rank=FALSE)
MEDIPS.plotSaturation(sr)
cor.matrix=MEDIPS.correlation(MSets=c(hESCs_MeDIP, DE_MeDIP, hESCs_Input, DE_Input), plot=T, method="pearson")
cr=MEDIPS.seqCoverage(file=bam.file.hESCs.Rep1.MeDIP, pattern="CG", BSgenome=BSgenome, chr.select=chr.select, extend=extend, shift=shift, uniq=uniq)
MEDIPS.plotSeqCoverage(seqCoverageObj=cr, type="pie", cov.level = c(0,1, 2, 3, 4, 5))
MEDIPS.plotSeqCoverage(seqCoverageObj=cr, type="hist", t = 15, main="Sequence pattern coverage, histogram")
er=MEDIPS.CpGenrich(file=bam.file.hESCs.Rep1.MeDIP, BSgenome=BSgenome, chr.select=chr.select, extend=extend, shift=shift, uniq=uniq)
